units.source_text: 二公主的着裳仪式正在此时举行，举国臣民都为此事奔忙。

en.t: The Second Princess's robe-wearing ceremony was being held at this time, and the whole country's officials and people were busy over it.

units.source_text: 一切准备工作，均由今上一人亲自筹划。

en.t: All the preparations were personally planned by the reigning emperor himself.

units.source_text: 故二公主虽然没有外戚做后援，着裳仪式的排场反而体面。

en.t: Thus, although the Second Princess had no maternal relatives to support her, the ceremony was all the more dignified and impressive.

units.source_text: 她母亲已故藤壶女御生前预先替她置备着的东西自不必说，此外又命宫中作物所新制许多用具。

en.t: Not to mention the things her late mother, Lady Fujitsubo, had prepared for her in advance while still alive, the emperor also ordered the palace workshops to make many new furnishings and utensils.

units.source_text: 几个国守也从外地进贡种种物品。

en.t: Several provincial governors also sent in various offerings from the provinces.
The ceremony was magnificent beyond compare.

units.source_text: 今上原定：二公主举行着裳式后即招薰中纳言为驸马。

en.t: The reigning emperor had originally decided that, after the Second Princess held her robe-wearing ceremony, he would at once invite Counselor Kaoru to become her husband.

units.source_text: 故此时男方也应该有所准备。

en.t: Therefore the groom's side too ought to have been making preparations at this time.

units.source_text: 然而薰中纳言照例脾气古怪，全然不把此事放在心上，他只管为二女公子生产之事担心。

en.t: However, Counselor Kaoru, eccentric as usual, paid no attention to this matter at all and concerned himself only with the Second Young Lady's childbirth.
